lyric: They say these are the golden years
lyric_idea: Refrain echo: the AI boom. Hundreds of billions in data-center spending (Stargate $500B), record valuations, and 'golden age' rhetoric. Never show the lyric itself.

candidates.text: Nvidia’s quarterly revenue doubles to nearly $100bn as CEO declares ‘golden age’
candidates.verified_how: Live page fetched: title and standfirst match. Body: Jensen Huang said the AI industry had reached a 'golden age'; revenue $96.2bn, up 106% year on year. Screenshot viewed locally. Deck manifest id nvidia-revenue-100bn-guardian, verified true.
candidates.why_it_fits: Literal golden-age rhetoric from the AI boom's own chief executive, so the phrase lands without the lyric being shown. The trim option reads in about 2 s on a phone.

candidates.text: OpenAI teams up with SoftBank and Oracle on $500B data center project
candidates.verified_how: Live page fetched: title reads 'OpenAI teams up with SoftBank and Oracle on $500B data center project | TechCrunch'. Body: the partners will 'pour up to $500 billion into the venture over the next four years'. Screenshot viewed locally. Deck manifest id techcrunch-stargate-500b. Note: the URL slug says '50b'; the headline text is $500B.
candidates.why_it_fits: This is the Stargate $500B figure from the brief, the build-out behind the 'golden years'. Caveat: the $500B is a plan of up to $500B over four years, not money already spent, so keep the on-screen wording to the headline.

candidates.text: Big Tech’s AI Spending to Reach $760 Billion in 2026 (subtitle: Annual capital expenditure of Meta, Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon)
candidates.trim_option: $760B: Meta $145B + Microsoft $190B + Alphabet $205B + Amazon $220B (2026, company projections)
candidates.verified_how: Chart image opened and read locally: title, per-company 2026 bars, and footnote ('upper limit of latest company projection as of Jul. 30, 2026'). The four bars sum to $760B. Deck manifest id statista-bigtech-capex-760b, verified true. Live Statista page not opened.
candidates.why_it_fits: The money behind the 'golden years' as one number a phone can read in about 2 s. Licence: CC BY-ND (stated on the image), so show it unaltered with credit; a crop or recolour may breach the no-derivatives term, so check before editing.

candidates.text: Anthropic raises $65 billion, nears $1T valuation ahead of IPO
candidates.verified_how: Screenshot viewed locally: headline, byline and date (May 28, 2026) match. Deck manifest id techcrunch-anthropic-965b, verified true, dek: '$65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation'. Live page not opened.
candidates.why_it_fits: Record-valuation rhetoric for the valuation beat of the boom. Caveat: 'nears $1T' is the headline's wording; the dek's $965B post-money is the closed figure, so quote the headline as written.
